call_purpose: Your webinar registration page was not sending the confirmation email, and your products page was showing the wrong currency.

resolved.text: We turned on the confirmation email for your webinar page and saved it, and after you registered with another email you confirmed the confirmation email arrived.
Following our guidance, you selected Indian Rupee in Settings, Regional and saved it, and you confirmed your products page now looks right.

covered.text: We explained that the currency is set in your account's regional settings, and only the account owner can change it.
